capabilities: Fetch HTML titles and rewrite selected raw URLs as Markdown links
Configure the URL-matching regex pattern in settings
Define site-specific title regex patterns for non-standard HTML
Fall back to Archive.org or Microlink API for bot-protected sites
Decode HTML entities in fetched page titles
disambiguation: Not a link checker or bookmark manager; it only rewrites raw URLs in the selected text as Markdown links using fetched page titles.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Microlink fallback sends URLs to a third-party service and its free tier is limited to 50 requests/day; both fallback services are disabled by default.
motivation: The author forked obsidian-url-namer to add configurable settings, multiple fallback methods for bot-protected sites, and improved URL handling.
problem: Obsidian leaves pasted URLs as raw text, and naming each link manually means opening every page to copy its title.

relations.evidence: the plugin uses Microlink API to fetch titles from protected sites
fetch titles from Archive.org's Wayback Machine if a site blocks direct access

summary: URL-to-link converter that fetches webpage titles and rewrites raw URLs in selected text as titled Markdown links.
